answer.evidence: Transmitter ageing at A-TX: TX bias climbed 43.06mA (13th) to 71.97mA (22nd) while TX power held +1.79dBm; bias then saturated ~72.8mA and TX power collapsed to -1.21dBm (26th), now measured -1.84dBm at A-TX, below the -1.0 to +2.0dBm spec. Rx fell in lockstep from -11.1 to -14.1dBm causing RX_LOW_WARNING. Fibre path is exonerated: A-TX to B-ODF loss = -1.84 to -9.5 = 7.66dB vs commissioning 7.61dB; attenuator B-ODF to B-RX = 5.1dB vs 5dB design; bidirectional embedded OTDR normal (SC-05 G.652/G.655 event 0.79/-0.74dB averages ~0dB), connectors clean. Corrective action: replace A transmitter.

args.evidence: Transmitter ageing at A-TX: TX bias climbed 43.06mA (13th) to 71.97mA (22nd) while TX power held +1.79dBm; bias then saturated ~72.8mA and TX power collapsed to -1.21dBm (26th), now measured -1.84dBm at A-TX, below the -1.0 to +2.0dBm spec. Rx fell in lockstep from -11.1 to -14.1dBm causing RX_LOW_WARNING. Fibre path is exonerated: A-TX to B-ODF loss = -1.84 to -9.5 = 7.66dB vs commissioning 7.61dB; attenuator B-ODF to B-RX = 5.1dB vs 5dB design; bidirectional embedded OTDR normal (SC-05 G.652/G.655 event 0.79/-0.74dB averages ~0dB), connectors clean. Corrective action: replace A transmitter.
